aspiration.success_looks_like: Lifting three times a week without thinking about it, cooking most weekday lunches, and losing a bit of the belly
aspiration.starting_point: Desk job, walks the dog daily, did gym classes years ago

domain_picture.routine: Skips breakfast, buys lunch near the office most days, cooks dinner three or four nights
domain_picture.skill: Cooks simple pasta and stir-fries; has never followed a lifting program; knows squats and push-ups from classes
domain_picture.limits: Home only: a pair of adjustable dumbbells up to 20 kg each and a bench; no allergies; 90 minutes on Sunday for meal prep
domain_picture.likes: Spicy food, chicken, rice, eggs; likes short workouts
domain_picture.dislikes: Fish, cottage cheese, running; hates long recipes with many pans

week_one_checkins: Strength: done, done, done. Replies: 'the goblet squats felt easy, could have done more', 'push-ups were hard by the last set'. Meal prep: partly done. Reply: 'the bean chili was fine but I was bored of it by Thursday, and it took nearly two hours'.
